original_specification.scale_policy: Store scene lengths in mm and angles in radians. Preserve physical feature size across part resizing. Preserve CAD dimensions and label the treatment as visual only.

validation: The recipe must not predict dimensional changes or solvent compatibility.
Check on a flat coupon, a curved part and an exposed edge under fixed neutral illumination; this is a proposed check, not a completed validation.

limitations: Illustrative authored RGB material; no measured optical/engineering certification.
